seed: inputs/seeds/job/spec (base.tla c411a201 rebase; actions.json verified identical to base.tla bodies)
method: Footprints machine-extracted from actions.json guards/updates (regex over EXCEPT paths, record selectors, helper-operator expansion: CurrentJob, CurrentToken, ReplySites, WaitDone, RegisteredAtSite, ResourceManagerUnlocked, RestartEligible; network kinds from Msg literals). Process cross-checked against instrumentation-hooks.json node. Group/mechanism/trigger assignment is manual.

JOB_SCHED.components: DefaultJobScheduler, JobRunner (run thread, start claim, failure cleanup, completion thread), job_cmds abort_job, FederatedServer outcome/heartbeat handlers, AdminServer waiters, JobDefManager status store
keeps_inside: start claim vs pre-run abort (_start_lock; U2/MC-3)
non-CAS status store writers: DISPATCHED, RUNNING, FAILED_TO_RUN, terminal, ABORTED, CANT_SCHEDULE (MC-3/MC-4 class)
pending-outcome set: start filter, fail_run clear, grace, heartbeat resolution
JOB_SCHED.adjustment_from_candidate: Candidate JOB_SCHED absorbs the admin abort command, outcome reception and heartbeat reconciliation because they read/write the same jobs.status/startClaim/pending/running fields; only the SJ-handle half of "abort" (terminate/remove) goes to JOB_SPENGINE.

sends: Cancel(s,tok) to dispatch (no_resource, admission error, startup failure)
Stop(s,<<j,issued[j]>>) to deployed (admin abort RUNNING, startup failure after SJ registered, accepted Failed/Aborted outcome while SJ registered, completion with a failure record serverFailed)
HeartbeatStop(s,tok) when CP still lists the token but SP has no registered SJ and no outcome key (or a failure record)
consumes: CheckOK/CheckNo, DeployOK/DeployNo, StartOK/StartNo, CancelAck (waiter; late replies discarded after timeout)
OutcomeOK/OutcomeFailed/OutcomeAborted (accepted iff s in pending, else ignored)
publishes: jobs.serverStop, jobs.adminPC, scheduler.pc, scheduler.current (read by SPENGINE until replaced by AbortSJ/SpawnSJ)

coarse_variant_must_reproduce: fresh token per scheduling attempt; several attempts for one job reach the same site (stale earlier-attempt reservations must still be possible)
Check broadcast, then possibly no Start at all (CANT_SCHEDULE, no_resource, abort, deploy failure) so reservations are left to TTL expiry or Cancel
Start arbitrarily late after CheckOK (expiry window) and only to deployed sites; never a second fresh-token Start for a running job
timeouts close waiters without retracting commands; late replies are tolerated
Stop at any time after Start for abort/failure, including while the CP is still STARTING; HeartbeatStop for jobs not registered at SP
outcome handling: accept once per pending site, ignore unknown, failure/aborted while active clears pending and sends Stop, missing outcome resolved by heartbeat or grace
MaxJobs concurrent tokens at a CP
SpawnSJ may be skipped (startup failure before spawn) and AbortSJ may be requested
fine_failure_outcomes: deploy exception / DeployNo / deploy timeout -> FAILED_TO_RUN (+Cancel)
StartNo/start timeout (strict or no OK site) -> FAILED_TO_RUN + Stop if registered
store error at DISPATCHED/RUNNING write -> failure path
pre-run abort -> ABORTED, claim rejected, no Start

keeps_inside: SJ registry lifetime: register -> exit observed or terminate -> remove
terminate branches (10 s grace, already-exited, abort-command error) and no-op remove
JOB_SPENGINE.adjustment_from_candidate: Candidate abort is split: admin abort/start-claim logic stays in JOB_SCHED; only the SJ-handle termination is here. Weakest of the proposed cuts: fail_run and wait_for_complete share engine.lock and the exit-code record; MC-4 is triggered through serverRegistered. Fallback: merge into JOB_SCHED as JOB_SP (no SP-internal port).

sends: SJ exit code into exception record (joint with ObserveExit after the split)
reads_foreign_state: scheduler.pc/current, jobs.adminPC, jobs.serverStop (JOB_SCHED; replace by SpawnSJ/AbortSJ)

coarse_variant_must_reproduce: spawn can fail (before any SJ exists)
after a successful spawn the registry entry can disappear at any later point (SJ exit) -- in particular before the runner writes RUNNING and before client outcomes arrive (MC-4 window)
termination occurrence is not physical exit; the registry can be removed after terminate while the SJ is still alive (CR-2 boundary)
abnormal SJ exit yields a failure code unless fail_run already recorded one (precedence)

JOB_CP.components: Check/Cancel/StartJobProcessor, AutoCleanResourceManager/ListResourceManager, ListResourceConsumer, ClientEngine.start_app/abort_app, JobExecutor (pending handle, waiter, notify_job_status, restart), ProcessJobLauncher/ProcessHandle, training_cmds deploy
keeps_inside: reservation TTL expiry vs allocate under the RM lock (#5191 context)
rollback free vs live child (MC-2) and cleanup-waiter handoff
shared parent environment vs per-token snapshot incl. restart re-snapshot (CR-1, Phase-1 MC-8)
restart generation vs stale/legacy status and READY reset (U3/U4)
one free per allocation; outcome report before free
JOB_CP.adjustment_from_candidate: As candidate. Restart and stale-status handling stay with the executor because generation, handle, waiter and allocation are one record (client[s][t]) and one lock.

sends: Outcome{OK,Failed,Aborted}(s,t) once per token after final exit
consumes: Check, Cancel, Deploy, Start, Stop, HeartbeatStop
Status(s,t,g,kind) and Exit(s,t,g,rc), Settlement(s,t,g,safe) from JOB_PROC [implicit today]
reads_foreign_state: network absence of own Outcome message (X4)

coarse_variant_must_reproduce: CheckOK and CheckNo both possible; capacity returns only after free; a CheckOK reservation can expire so a later Start gets StartNo
Cancel never frees an allocation
StartOK then exactly one eventual outcome report, or a report failure/loss with the job later absent from heartbeat
StartNo after a spawn (MC-2): child still running, still listed in heartbeat, no outcome report, unit freed and reusable by the next Check
StartOK can follow a Stop consumed during STARTING (pending abort)
Stop/HeartbeatStop lead to abort, eventual exit and an Aborted/Failed/OK report
restart keeps the token/allocation, emits one final report, may expose READY again for a new generation
outcome kind from exit code: generic rc -> Failed unless abort was requested or the CJ already reported STOPPED (then OK); failed -> Failed; aborted -> Aborted; ok -> OK
fine_failure_outcomes: abnormal exit -> restart (eligible) or Failed report

Its implicit outputs (status notifications, rc, can_restart evidence) are currently chosen inside JOB_CP actions and must move onto the port.

coarse_variant_must_reproduce: CJ/SJ exit at any time after spawn, including before READY/StartOK (early crash) and never-forced (children may outlive rollback, MC-2)
failure and aborted exit codes
stale (old-generation) and legacy (g=0) status after replacement; STOPPED followed by late READY
in integrated mixes: READY only after CJ runner init, exits after END_RUN/workflow done (replace with fedavg runner groups)

jobs.adminPC.note: Admin abort command PC. Read by JOB_SPENGINE terminate guards (adminPC="stopWait") = oracle on the caller thread; replace with AbortSJ(j) request.

jobs.serverAborted.note: Second bit of the exception record (ABORTED code from fail_run). Written and read only by JOB_SCHED; travels with serverFailed if that record moves.

jobs.serverAlive.note: SJ physical liveness. Set TRUE by ServerEngineSpawnJob (SP), FALSE by ServerChildExit/Failure (SJ), read by ServerEngineObserveExit (process.wait). Resolve: JOB_PROC owns sj[j].alive; spawn is a joint SPENGINE/PROC step (Popen returns a live child); ObserveExit consumes an Exit(j,rc) event.

jobs.serverFailed.note: engine.exception_run_processes[j] (authoritative failure code). Written by fed_server/fail_run outcome receivers + heartbeat ResolveMissingOutcome (JOB_SCHED) and by ServerChildFailure (SJ exit with error; JOB_PROC). In code the SJ code is recorded by wait_for_complete (server_engine.py:220-234) under engine.lock in the same critical section that pops run_processes, with precedence vs fail_run (job_runner.py:903-925). The seed sets it at physical exit (before ObserveExit): over-approximation/shortcut. Resolve: JOB_SCHED owns the record; SJ code arrives with the SPENGINE exit observation as a joint step (ObserveExit + record) -- a separate later consume step would let SelectCompletion classify COMPLETED in between (spurious).

jobs.serverRegistered.note: engine.run_processes membership. Written only by JOB_SPENGINE (Register, ObserveExit, RemoveAfterTerminate); read by 9 JOB_SCHED actions (completion selection, failure cleanup, abort, outcome receivers, heartbeat). Published read-only port state (same process, engine.lock).

jobs.serverSpawned.note: Spawn occurred (observer). Also used by JobRefinement Abs.serverLaunched.

jobs.serverStop.note: Abort request flag (job_runner._stop_run -> engine.abort_app_on_server). Written by JOB_SCHED (failure stop, admin abort, fail_run); read by JOB_SPENGINE terminate guards. Becomes AbortSJ(j) request message.

jobs.serverTerminated.note: Termination occurred (observer, not a guard of SJ exit).

cross_access.what: Heartbeat content: CP heartbeat lists the jobs it still runs (fed_server.py:1013-1026; client/communicator.py:729-754). Seed reads it atomically with no heartbeat message/staleness.
